spanish: Y apoyará su mano sobre la cabeza del pecado, y degollará el pecado en el lugar del holocausto.
grammarChanges: Added missing definite article: "sobre la cabeza" (was "sobre cabeza").

בִּמְקוֹם (ב + construct מָקוֹם, place, bound to definite הָעֹלָה) was rendered with the substitution idiom "en lugar del holocausto" (instead of); corrected to the locative "en el lugar del holocausto" (at the place of the burnt offering) to keep the place noun per audit.
